meta.title: Saiyan Ascend
meta.description: Train with focus. Progress with consistency. Ascend on your terms.

brand.name: Saiyan Ascend
brand.tagline: Train with focus. Progress with consistency.

home.headline: Your training arena starts here
home.supporting: Sign in to reach today's mission shell. Programmes and workouts arrive in later milestones — no fabricated stats.

login.title: Sign in
login.subtitle: Continue to your Saiyan Ascend member shell.

register.title: Create account
register.subtitle: Start with a secure member account. Onboarding comes next.

today.title: Today
today.noStats: No invented workout statistics are shown — only real planned sessions and logged sets. Meal intake appears only from meal logs.

training.noPlanBody: You do not have an active plan yet. Preview a plan from your profile and screening, then activate it when eligible.
training.restBody: Rest and sustainable consistency count as progress. Check Train for upcoming planned sessions.

media.title: Today’s word
media.notAuthentic: (Original app copy — not a Dragon Ball quotation.)

fuel.title: Fuel
fuel.subtitle: Meal plans, swaps, and logged intake — planned meals stay separate from what you actually eat.

empty.title: No active meal plan
empty.body: There is no active meal plan yet. Preview a seven-day plan from your diet preference, then activate it when eligible. We do not invent intake macros without meal logs.

targets.title: Nutrition targets
targets.body: Habit-only is the default. Calorie figures appear only when the API returns an estimated or professional target mode — never as guarantees.
targets.empty: No target activated in this visit. You can still preview a habit-only target or activate a meal plan without calorie targets.
targets.estimateDisclaimer: Estimate only — not a guarantee or clinical prescription
targets.habitOnlyNote: Habit-only mode: no calorie target is shown.
targets.noToken: Activate requires a valid preview token.

current.title: Active meal plan
current.partial: This plan is partial — some meal slots may be empty.

planPreview.eligibleCount: {count} eligible recipes after diet and allergy filters
planPreview.partial: Preview is partial — not every slot could be filled.
planPreview.notActivatable: This preview cannot be activated (no preview token).

activate.noToken: Activate requires a valid preview token.

planned.title: Planned meals
planned.subtitle: These are scheduled recipes — not recorded intake until you mark them eaten.
planned.empty: No remaining planned meals to show, or all listed meals were marked eaten this visit.

consumed.title: Logged this visit
consumed.subtitle: Only meal logs created in this browser session are listed here. There is no invented daily intake total.
consumed.empty: No meals logged yet this visit. Mark a planned meal as eaten to record intake.
consumed.macrosNote: Logged estimate: {kcal} kcal (from recipe/log source — not a guarantee)

swap.noCandidates: No eligible swap candidates after diet and allergy filters.
swap.success: Meal swapped. Grocery list refreshed when available.
swap.noToken: Swap confirm requires a valid preview token.

grocery.title: Grocery list
grocery.needsPlan: Activate a meal plan to generate a grocery list.
grocery.empty: No grocery items for the active plan yet.

explanations.HABIT_ONLY_NO_ENERGY_TARGET: Habit-only mode does not set an energy target.
explanations.MEAL_PLAN_GENERATED: A meal plan was generated from eligible recipes.
explanations.MEAL_PLAN_PARTIAL: The meal plan could not fill every slot.
explanations.ALLERGY_FILTER_APPLIED: Allergy exclusion hard rules were applied.
explanations.SOFT_ENERGY_PROXIMITY: Soft energy proximity was used as a ranking hint only.
explanations.SWAP_CANDIDATES_RANKED: Swap candidates were ranked by fit.
explanations.NO_SWAP_CANDIDATES: No swap candidates remained after filters.

train.title: Train
train.subtitle: Preview, activate, and run workouts matched to your constraints — not to a character theme.

errors.missingProfile: Your profile version is missing. Finish onboarding, then try again.
errors.missingScreening: A screening record is required before plan preview. Finish onboarding screening first.

empty.title: No active plan
empty.body: There is no active training plan yet. Preview a candidate from your current profile and screening. We only show explainable eligibility from the API — never fabricated progress.

preview.noCandidate: No candidate programme is available for your current constraints.
preview.notActivatable: This preview cannot be activated (no preview token). Resolve eligibility first.

activate.noToken: Activate requires a valid preview token.

eligibility.PROFESSIONAL_GUIDANCE_REQUIRED: Professional guidance is required before automated planning
eligibility.TEMPORARY_TRAINING_PAUSE: Temporary training pause — automated plans are blocked

explanations.NO_ELIGIBLE_TEMPLATE: No published template matches your equipment, time, and screening constraints.
explanations.TEMPLATE_SELECTED: A template was selected from eligible candidates.
explanations.SOME_EXERCISES_EXCLUDED_FOR_EQUIPMENT: Some exercises were excluded because of available equipment.
explanations.SOME_EXERCISES_EXCLUDED_FOR_SCREENING: Some exercises were excluded because of screening restrictions.
explanations.CHARACTER_EMPHASIS_BIAS_ONLY: Character theme may bias preference ranking only.
explanations.CHARACTER_CANNOT_OVERRIDE_CONSTRAINTS: Character theme cannot override safety, recovery, or equipment limits.
explanations.BUSY_DAY_NO_SHORTEN_NEEDED: No shortening was needed for the target duration.
explanations.BUSY_DAY_DROPPED_OPTIONAL: Optional exercises were dropped for a busy day.
explanations.BUSY_DAY_KEPT_MINIMUM_CORE: A minimum core set was kept.
explanations.BUSY_DAY_TRIMMED_CORE: Core volume was trimmed for time.

sessions.title: Planned sessions
sessions.empty: No planned sessions yet. Activate a plan to schedule workouts.

player.title: Workout
player.subtitle: Log sets honestly. Complete or abandon when you finish.
player.noMedia: Exercise demos are not shown as licensed media. Follow the written instructions only.
player.completeSuccess: Workout completed. Earned XP is recorded on Progress (game level is not a health outcome).

onboarding.title: Set up your training profile
onboarding.subtitle: Answer each step honestly. Your programme stays personalised to you — not to a character theme.

welcome.ageNote: You must be an adult to use Saiyan Ascend. Enter your date of birth.

consent.terms: I agree to the Terms of Service (tos-v1).
consent.privacy: I agree to the Privacy Policy (privacy-v1).
consent.health: I consent to health-related data processing for training safety (health-data-v1).

goals.hint: Choose one or more goals. Any gender may choose any goal.

screening.disclaimer: These are member-reported signals for safety routing — not a medical diagnosis. Screening outcomes always override character themes.
screening.reportsUrgentSymptoms: I am experiencing urgent symptoms that make exercise unsafe right now
screening.reportsChestPain: I experience chest pain related to activity
screening.reportsFainting: I have fainted or nearly fainted with exertion
screening.reportsSevereBreathingDifficulty: I have severe breathing difficulty with activity
screening.reportsActiveInjuryAffectingExercise: I have an active injury that affects exercise
screening.reportsClinicianRestriction: A clinician has restricted my exercise
screening.requiresTemporaryPause: I need a temporary training pause

measurements.hint: You may skip. We never invent nutrition values from missing data.

character.disclaimer: Your programme stays personalised to your goals, screening, equipment, and recovery. Character selection is a motivational theme only — it cannot override safety limits.
character.originalOnly: Showing ORIGINAL published archetypes. These are product-owned themes, not Dragon Ball licensed assets.
character.unavailable: No character presentations are available in the active content mode.

notifications.hint: Optional. You can change these later.
notifications.push: Enable push reminders (when delivery is configured)
notifications.email: Enable email reminders (when delivery is configured)
notifications.simulated: Preference only — this milestone does not send real push or email.

planPreview.body: Later milestones will generate training and nutrition from your profile, screening, and availability. Rest and sustainable consistency count as progress.
planPreview.noFakeStats: No workout or meal statistics are shown here — we do not invent member data or body-transformation predictions.
planPreview.acknowledge: I understand programmes are personalised and character theme does not change safety rules

confirm.body: Review that required setup is saved, then finish onboarding.
confirm.noStats: No fabricated workout or meal stats will appear after you continue.
confirm.acknowledge: I confirm my answers and want to complete onboarding

admin.title: Administration
admin.subtitle: Protected admin shell
admin.body: Content management, programme review, and operations tools arrive in later milestones. This shell confirms ADMIN access only.
admin.deniedBody: This area requires the ADMIN role. Member accounts cannot enter administration.

progress.title: Progress
progress.subtitle: Earned activity points from sustainable actions. This is a game ledger — not a health score.
progress.disclaimer: Game level is cosmetic progression only. It is not a health outcome, body transformation, or medical prediction.

milestones.title: Cosmetic unlocks
milestones.body: Unlocks change presentation only. Switching character keeps your XP and unlock history.

ledger.title: XP ledger
ledger.body: Append-only awards. Retries and duplicate sources do not inflate totals.
ledger.empty: No XP entries yet. Complete a sustainable main mission (workout or planned rest) to earn points.

auth.sessionExpired: Your session expired. Please sign in again.
auth.logoutError: Could not sign out cleanly. Try again.

errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.network: Cannot reach the API. Confirm it is running and NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL is set.
errors.validation: Check the highlighted fields and try again.
errors.conflict: An account with this email already exists.
errors.forbidden: You do not have permission for this action.
